elements.name: slide-subtitle
elements.text: Target: 10 weeks, subject to the selected design, agreed working availability and confirmed pilot workflow.

Week	Milestone	Planned output
Week 1	Confirm the system	Confirm one design, pilot records, roles, public fields and whether processors combine harvests.
Week 2	Build the foundation	Build MongoDB, the Express/Node.js API and sign-in. Test account access and role restrictions.
Week 3	Organize the ecosystem	Build farm, produce, partner and account forms. Test saving, editing and permitted access.
Week 4	Capture farming details	Add planting, plot and care records. Test required fields, dates and record corrections.
Week 5	Track harvest batches	Add harvest IDs, quantities and status. Review the growing-to-harvest workflow with pilot users.

elements.name: text-66
elements.text: Confirm the chosen redesign before kickoff. Testing starts during development in Week 2.
